welcome.title: Welcome to Bali Smile Trip & Travel
welcome.paragraph1: Founded by Dewa Wahya, a dedicated Balinese local with many years of experience in the tourism and hospitality industry, our mission is simple: to create personal, meaningful, and unforgettable travel experiences in Bali.
welcome.paragraph2: We go beyond standard transportation — we share stories, insights, and the authentic essence of Bali during every trip.

testimonials.title: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.subtitle: Our guests come from around the world, and many return or recommend us.

elliott.name: Elliot L.
elliott.review: Overall, Dewa is an incredibly knowledgeable, kind, safe, and flexible driver who I would recommend to any and all.

frank.name: Frank C.
frank.review: Dewa was exceptional and I highly recommend him to everyone visiting Bali. He is an expert of the island, very quick to communicate and flexible depending on your timing and desires for the day.

wendy.name: Wendy Y.
wendy.review: The guide did an excellent job, taking us to many beautiful places with all the necessary extras. A wonderful person, very knowledgeable about Bali's history, 100% recommended. ✨

cta.title: Let Us Be Your Local Friend in Bali
cta.description: Whether you seek romance, family bonding, luxury comfort, or adventurous exploration, Bali Smile Trip & Travel is here to create a journey you'll remember forever.
